---
title: "Wang-Chen System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& yz+a\\
\dot{y} &=& x^2+by\\
\dot{z} &=& 1-x
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.1,b=-2$ and initial condition $(-3,8,1)$.
